card.title: Keep the Peace
card.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that letter under my plate. We only just managed breakfast together again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother cancelled paying us back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've covered this month's rent. We don't need another suitcase in the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please finish breakfast with me first. Yesterday you finally unpacked; I can't risk you packing again.

mechanism: A hides a repayment letter to protect a fragile reunion from another departure-triggering conflict.
confusable: Unlike generic secrecy, A must explicitly connect disclosure to the feared end of the relationship.
comparison: D87-a protects a newly resumed breakfast and unpacked suitcase; D87-b protects anniversary dinner and shared space from another family-money dispute.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
